{"prob_violation": 0.05, "expected_voi": 0.2, "compute_cost": 1, "script": "import pathlib, importlib.util, time, json, base64, hmac, hashlib
def _load():
    for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py'):
        try:
            t = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            if 'class AuthMiddleware' in t:
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('auth_under_test', str(p))
                mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
                return mod.AuthMiddleware
        except Exception:
            continue
    raise ImportError('AuthMiddleware not found')
AuthMiddleware = _load()
def _b64url_encode(d: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(d).decode().rstrip('=')
SECRET='test-secret-123'

def test_valid_roundtrip():
    a = AuthMiddleware(secret=SECRET, public_paths=['/health'])
    tok = a.create_token({'sub':'user1'})
    payload = a.verify_token(tok)
    assert payload is not None and payload.get('sub')=='user1'
    ok, data = a.authenticate('/api/data', f'Bearer {tok}')
    assert ok is True

def test_alg_none_rejected():
    a = AuthMiddleware(secret=SECRET)
    hdr = _b64url_encode(json.dumps({'alg':'none','typ':'JWT'}, separators=(',',':')).encode())
    pl = _b64url_encode(json.dumps({'sub':'x','exp': int(time.time())+3600}, separators=(',',':')).encode())
    tok = f'{hdr}.{pl}.'
    assert a.verify_token(tok) is None
    ok,_ = a.authenticate('/api', f'Bearer {tok}')
    assert ok is False

def test_tampered_sig_rejected():
    a = AuthMiddleware(secret=SECRET)
    tok = a.create_token({'sub':'u'})
    h,p,s = tok.split('.')
    bad = s[:-1] + ('A' if s[-1]!='A' else 'B')
    assert a.verify_token(f'{h}.{p}.{bad}') is None

def test_tampered_payload_rejected():
    a = AuthMiddleware(secret=SECRET)
    tok = a.create_token({'sub':'u'})
    h,p,s = tok.split('.')
    pad='='*(-len(p)%4)
    data=json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p+pad).decode())
    data['sub']='admin'
    p2=_b64url_encode(json.dumps(data, separators=(',',':')).encode())
    assert a.verify_token(f'{h}.{p2}.{s}') is None

def test_expired_rejected():
    a = AuthMiddleware(secret=SECRET)
    tok = a.create_token({'sub':'u'}, expires_in=-10)
    assert a.verify_token(tok) is None
    ok,msg = a.authenticate('/api', f'Bearer {tok}')
    assert ok is False and 'expired' in str(msg).lower()

def test_public_exact_no_overmatch():
    a = AuthMiddleware(secret=SECRET, public_paths=['/login'])
    ok,_ = a.authenticate('/login', None)
    assert ok is True
    ok2,_ = a.authenticate('/loginx', None)
    assert ok2 is False
    ok3,_ = a.authenticate('/login/extra', None)
    assert ok3 is False

def test_public_wildcard():
    a = AuthMiddleware(secret=SECRET, public_paths=['/public/*'])
    assert a.authenticate('/public/a', None)[0] is True
    assert a.authenticate('/private', None)[0] is False

def test_missing_and_bad_header():
    a = AuthMiddleware(secret=SECRET)
    assert a.authenticate('/api', None)[0] is False
    assert a.authenticate('/api', '')[0] is False
    assert a.authenticate('/api', 'Token xyz')[0] is False
